claims: As of April 1, 2026, many users are experiencing a widespread Chime app outage.
The Chime app outage is causing login failures and errors.
79% of issues reported are in the Chime app.
Users are reporting trouble logging in to the Chime app.
Users are reporting trouble viewing balances in the Chime app.
Users are reporting trouble transferring funds in the Chime app.
Reports suggest the Chime outage is widespread rather than specific to a region.
Card purchases are reportedly functioning normally.
ATM transactions are reportedly functioning normally.
Chime is currently investigating the service disruption.
